sentences.text: The writ petition was filed in the year 2018, no reply came for seven years, on 09.12.2025,
direction was given to file reply but in a casual manner, the Circle Officer, Mahishi, Saharsa informed that reply is being prepared.

5. In that background, he shall be paying Rs. 3,000/- to learned counsel for the petitioner, Mr.
Shashank Shekhar Jha and receipt has to be filed in the office by 16.02.2026.

6. Heard the parties.
7.

The present application has been preferred for the following relief(s):
(i) Issuance of a writ/direction including a order of writ in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondents to release the compensation amount of the acquired land according to market value after rectification of type of land as 'residential' by the Govt. of Bihar at Village- Gandaul, Than No.-72, Anchal Mahishi, District- Saharsa,
which is acquired for construction of Link road with R.C.C. Bridge as enhancement breath of of the existing Road (State Highway) No. 17.

(ii) Issuance a direction also to of follow all the procedure Acquisition in accordance with RFCTLARR- Act-2013 (Right to Fair compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Re- settlement Act-2013) and classify the type of land as 'Residential instead of 'Dhanber-2. or Patna High Court CWJC No.25104 of 2018(3) dt.03-02-2026 Veeth-2'.
(iii) Any other relief/reliefs may be granted to petitioners as he is found entitled to in the facts and circumstances of the case for the ends of Justice.
3. The matter relates to Land Acquisition Case No. 04 of 2013-14 for construction of Link road with R.C.C. Bridge over Kosi river.

opennyai_summary.decision:

7. As no further development is on record, the writ petition is disposed of with the following observations:
(i) if the petitioners have received the award with/without protest, the remedy lies before appropriate authority for enhancement of compensation;
